name: Public Service & Institutional

designIntent.primaryGoal: Help people complete important tasks correctly, confidently and with minimal ambiguity.
designIntent.visualThesis: Clarity, predictable behavior and plain language are the visual identity.

visualDirection.density: low-to-medium on task pages; information-rich pages use clear section hierarchy
visualDirection.surfaces: minimal decoration, strong section boundaries and explicit progress
visualDirection.colorIntent: high contrast, stable link styling and distinct but redundant feedback states
visualDirection.typography: legible system fonts where appropriate; prioritize reading ease and language coverage
visualDirection.motion: minimal; never obstruct forms or status feedback

layout.pattern: service landing page + task steps + clear form or confirmation state
layout.spacing: consistent, generous around questions and form controls
layout.responsive: single-column content with no loss of legal or eligibility information

accessibility.focus: visible and predictable focus, with error summary focus management
accessibility.reducedMotion: no essential progress depends on transition or animation

antiPatterns: primary action hidden below unrelated content
notes: Prefer tested plain language and direct task flows over decorative institutional branding.

aiGuidance.primaryFlow: Understand the service → check eligibility and requirements → complete the task → review → submit → track outcome.
prioritize: What the service does and who can use it
Required documents, eligibility and steps before commitment
Plain-language instructions, error recovery and confirmation
confirmOrMarkUnknown: Accepted documents, fees, deadlines and eligibility criteria
Whether submission and status data are live or illustrative
avoidByDefault: Invented legal claims or eligibility decisions
Marketing copy in critical service instructions
acceptanceChecks: People can understand eligibility before starting
Form errors are specific, associated with fields and recoverable
A review step shows exactly what will be submitted

compositionEscapes.when: People need to find and understand one public or institutional service.
compositionEscapes.composition: Start with the task name and plain-language summary, then order eligibility, requirements, time/cost and the start action by user need.

compositionEscapes.when: The central task is completing a multi-step application, declaration or request.
compositionEscapes.composition: Use one coherent step at a time with clear progress, field instructions, an error summary and a final review before submission.
contentRequirements: Actual field definitions and validation rules
avoid: Claiming a submission that did not occur

compositionEscapes.when: People need to understand what happened after submission and what they must do next.
compositionEscapes.composition: Present the current verified status and timestamp first, then chronological history, requested actions and contact/appeal route.
contentRequirements: Status definitions from the responsible service
Accurate timestamp and reference number when relevant
